decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website, so the firm has invested and committed little to it, but it fits the firm's construction equipment line and there is no clear evidence of failure, so management is likely to keep it for now.

The inclined furniture lift was presented on its own page as part of a visible lift family, and that public commitment and investment make management inclined to persist and blame any weak results on temporary conditions.

The inclined building material lift has its own page and ties into the firm's construction and material-handling direction, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment that management would have to justify.

The truck-mounted furniture lift was presented prominently on its own page, which implies development investment and public commitment that management is reluctant to abandon, even if it is the most niche variant of the lift family.
